canonical_payload.head: codex/native-input-chain-boundary-20261009
canonical_payload.title: fix(integration): gate native pair processing on authenticated input
canonical_payload.body:
A manifest claiming native business input could continue into Candidate/Evidence processing even when the connector returned HOLD. Require a verified exact-source connector result before reading that pair. Supply the read-only Actions token on main push, include connector contracts in automatic path coverage, and preserve failure diagnostics.

Validation: native-input boundary regression tests, authenticated transport and business-input suites passed; exact-pair regression including 27 negative checks passed. Rollback: revert this change.

Scope: reversible internal connection hardening for AUTONOMOUS_NORMAL_OPERATIONS_CLOSURE_MISSION. This does not register a producer, acquire provider data, prove any of the 13 domains, or authorize remote storage. Lawful current transaction/liquidity input and native domain producers remain missing. Production/Public/G5/provider activation remain HOLD.
